verdict.rationale: Convex ships official TypeScript/JavaScript SDKs, a documented CLI, HTTP API, and an official MCP server for AI agents, with hands-on probes confirming the CLI runs headlessly and the MCP server responds to JSON-RPC handshakes—strong evidence of first-party agent/SDK support. Docs also explicitly promote agent-friendly workflows (llms.txt, agent-setup guide, coding-agent compatibility).
